lines.text: This is a simulated benchmark: two alloy discovery campaigns, replayed for a whole year in a digital twin of our planned automated lab.

Some of it comes from real sources: the lab's design and its 3-D model, footage from our own atomizer, the search spaces in the two proposals, and published prices. Everything else is simulated: every alloy, every measurement, and every result.

From day two, the event log moves the lab's 3-D model: each booking brings its tray to a Shuttle's opening and back, and a mobile arm drives over to serve it. Trays nobody has booked stay in their slots.
Now the whole lab from above, with the two Shuttles up close from a second camera. The moves run on a clock of their own, so you can follow them; the panel at the bottom counts how many were drawn.
